evidence_sentence: It limits the size of the data to be written to the maximum allowable value to prevent overflow.
rationale: The vulnerable implementation passes s directly to the format-specific write function without imposing a maximum. Only the fixed implementation introduces max_write and clamps s when it exceeds INT_MAX. The docstring explicitly describes this fixed-only size limit and mitigation purpose.
rewritten_docstring: This function checks the magic number of the archive to ensure it is in the correct state for writing data. It prepares the requested data size for writing. It clears any previous errors and then calls the format-specific write function to perform the actual data writing.
